main_reasons: Filing itself discloses error corrections: FY2024 restated (10-K/A, April 2026) and all three 2025 interim quarters restated for numerous errors (ARO discount rate, vendor invoice cut-off, royalties, revenue cut-off, unrecorded CEO put right, unbifurcated conversion options, capitalized workover costs not yet incurred, NCI allocation) following SEC comment letters

Material weaknesses across basic processes (account reconciliations, segregation of duties, complex instruments, oil and gas controls); ineffective ICFR and disclosure controls; no auditor ICFR attestation

No impairment recorded on $82.0M net proved properties although proved reserves fell from 14.5 to 2.8 MMBoe, PUDs went to zero, standardized measure is only $31.2M, and undiscounted future net cash flows are negative after tax (about $13M pre-tax); recoverability appears to rely on probable reserves

$13.4M gain on sale of ORRIs/farmout depends on judgmental allocation of $45.5M bundled proceeds toward 'zero-basis' unproved interests, while the proved-property ORRI is treated inconsistently (cost-basis reduction yet a $10.3M loss); ORRI carries capital-commitment escalators suggestive of financing
$13.4M related-party debt extinguishment credited to equity, $17M NCI reclassification and numerous Level 3 Monte Carlo derivative valuations give management wide latitude over reported equity

Severe distress: going concern, $375K cash, $21.8M working-capital deficit, negative operating cash flow, toxic ELOC/convertible financing, deferred executive salaries, very late filing (FY2025 10-K filed September 2026), auditor change from Marcum to CBIZ
